recipes.title: Orange Juice Cookies
ingredients: ½ can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
Frosting: a little melted butter (quantity not specified)
Frosting: a little thawed orange juice (quantity not specified)
steps: Cream the first three ingredients: sugar, margarine, and eggs.
Add the remaining dough ingredients gradually.
Drop onto cookie sheets.
Bake at 350°F for 10 minutes.
When cool, frost with a little melted butter, a little thawed orange juice, and powdered sugar. Frosting quantities are not specified.

recipes.title: Quick Mix Spritz
steps: Cream shortening, sugar, and egg. The printed directions say “eggs,” while the ingredient list specifies 1 egg.
Gradually add dry ingredients.
When you can form a ball, add food coloring.
Press cookies onto cookie sheet.
Bake at 375°F for 10–12 minutes.
recipes.sourceNotes: Vanilla is listed in the ingredients; the printed directions do not say when to add it.

recipes.title: Pancakes
steps: Whisk all ingredients together.
recipes.notes: When doubling, use 1½ cups flour total instead of 1 cup.
recipes.sourceNotes: The handwritten recipe does not give cooking directions beyond whisking, or specify a cooking time or temperature.

recipes.title: Deanna’s Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs.
Mix dry ingredients.
Drop onto cookie sheet and sprinkle with sugar before baking.
Bake at 350°F for 8–10 minutes.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Herb Bread
steps: In a large bowl, dissolve 1 teaspoon sugar in warm water, then sprinkle yeast on top. Let stand 5–7 minutes, or until yeast starts to foam. Stir to dissolve yeast.
Add the next eight dough ingredients (through salt) to yeast mixture. Beat in mixer on low until moistened, then on medium for 2 minutes.
Work in the additional cup of flour with a dough hook.
Grease slow cooker and place dough in middle. Smooth top with a wet spoon.
Place 5 paper towels between lid and slow cooker. Place toothpicks between cooker and lid to allow steam to escape.
Cook 2½ hours on high. Do not lift lid.
When done, turn off slow cooker and loosen sides with a knife.

recipes.title: Corn Relish Crisps
ingredients: Pointed rolled sugar ice cream cones or metal cone shapes
3/4 cup crème fraîche or sour cream
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. In a small bowl, stir together flour, cilantro, sugar, salt, and red pepper; set aside.
In a medium mixing bowl, beat butter with an electric mixer on medium to high speed until fluffy. Beat in egg whites until combined. Beat in flour mixture until combined.

Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper. For each shell, drop one heaping teaspoon of batter onto the prepared sheet. Using the back of a spoon, spread batter into a 3-inch circle. Repeat with remaining batter, baking only five or six crisps at a time.
Bake 6–7 minutes or until bubbly and golden brown on edges. Remove from oven. Allow to cool 15 seconds.
Working quickly, roll each warm crisp around a pointed ice cream cone or metal cone. Allow to cool; remove from cones and set aside. Or transfer flat crisps to a cooling rack to cool.
To serve, in a small mixing bowl combine sour cream and chives. Spoon 1–2 teaspoons of the mixture into each shell. Top with 1/2 teaspoon corn relish. Arrange on a serving platter.

recipes.title: Seasoned Oyster Crackers
steps: Mix first four ingredients together well. Toss together with crackers and bake at 350°F for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Dilled Baby Carrots
steps: Place carrots in a saucepan, cover with water and bring to a boil. Cook 8 minutes or until tender.
Drain and return to pan. Toss with remaining ingredients.

recipes.title: Bean and Parsley Salad
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Toss to combine.

recipes.title: Greek-Style Oven Fries
steps: Cut each potato into wedges. Combine the next six ingredients in a large bowl. Add potatoes and toss well to coat.
Place skin side down on a baking sheet sprayed with cooking spray. Bake until tender and lightly browned at 400°F for about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Parslied Potatoes
steps: Peel a strip around each potato and set aside.
Sauté onions and garlic 5 minutes or until tender. Add broth and 3/4 cup parsley, mix well and bring to a boil.
Place potatoes in skillet and return to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, covered, for 10 minutes or until tender.
Remove potatoes to a serving bowl. Add pepper to skillet and stir. Pour sauce over potatoes and sprinkle with remaining parsley.

recipes.title: Garden Lite Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 package (10 ounces) frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and well drained
1/2 pound carrots or zucchini, sliced, cooked and drained
6 slices light cheese, cut into small pieces
steps: Prepare pasta.
In a large saucepan, cook onion and garlic in margarine until tender. Stir in flour, salt and thyme. Gradually stir in milk. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture thickens.
Stir in cheese. Cook and stir until melted. Add broccoli, carrots and mushrooms; heat through. Serve sauce over hot pasta.

recipes.title: Baked Potato Chips
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Slice potatoes lengthwise very thin, about 1/16 inch.
Brush 2 baking sheets with 1/2 tablespoon olive oil each. Rub garlic over surface, pressing hard to extract as much garlic juice as possible. Place baking sheets in oven to warm for 5 minutes.

Place potato slices side by side on hot baking sheets. Sprinkle generously with salt and pepper. Bake 7–10 minutes, rotate pans for even browning and bake another 10–15 minutes. Flip potatoes and bake 5 minutes longer or until golden.
Remove and cool on paper towels. Repeat with remaining potato slices. Eat warm or store in airtight containers. Serve with herb and cheese dip.

recipes.title: Herb and Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 large garlic clove, peeled and finely minced
2 cups sour cream or plain yogurt
steps: In a medium bowl, combine all ingredients and mix well. Season to taste with additional salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Mostaccioli with Tomatoes and Basil
steps: Combine all ingredients except pasta and cheese. Let stand for 1 hour at room temperature.
Cook pasta; toss with tomatoes while pasta is hot and sprinkle with cheese. Garnish with additional basil leaves if desired.

recipes.title: Double-Dark Fudge Brownie Cake
steps: Grease and flour one 9-inch cake pan.
In a saucepan over medium heat, bring corn syrup and margarine to a boil, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat. Add chocolate and stir until melted. Add sugar.
Stir in eggs one at a time, then vanilla, flour, and nuts. Pour into prepared pan.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool in pan for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemony Green Beans
steps: Place beans in a large saucepan of boiling water; cook 5 minutes or until crisp-tender. Drain.
Plunge beans into ice water; drain and set aside.
Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add shallots; sauté 5 minutes or until golden.
Add green beans, lemon rind, and lemon juice; cook 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat; stir in salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Raw Salsa
ingredients: Juice of 1 lemon and 1 lime, optional for added zest
steps: Allow mixture to sit until flavors have blended, approximately 1 hour.
For added zest, add the juice of 1 lemon and 1 lime.

recipes.title: Thai Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 to 2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes
Peeled baby carrots and other vegetables for dipping
steps: In a bowl, combine spinach, sour cream, and yogurt.
Stir in mint, peanuts, peanut butter, honey, soy sauce, and red pepper flakes.
Cover and chill for 2 to 24 hours. Serve with vegetables.

recipes.title: Hummingbird Cake
ingredients: 3 cups all-purpose flour, plus more for pans
1 can (8 ounces) crushed pineapple in juice, undrained
2 cups chopped ripe bananas, about 6 bananas
2 packages (8 ounces each) cream cheese, softened
1 cup salted butter or margarine, softened
steps: Prepare the cake layers: Preheat oven to 350°F. Whisk together flour, sugar, salt, baking soda, and cinnamon in a large bowl. Add eggs and oil, stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened. Stir in vanilla, pineapple, bananas, and toasted pecans.
Divide batter evenly among three 9-inch round cake pans, well greased with shortening and floured.

Bake in preheated oven until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean, 25 to 30 minutes. Cool in pans on wire racks 10 minutes. Remove from pans to wire racks and cool completely, about 1 hour.

Prepare cream cheese frosting: Beat cream cheese and butter with an electric mixer on medium-low speed until smooth. Gradually add powdered sugar, beating at low speed until blended after each addition. Stir in vanilla. Increase speed to medium-high and beat until fluffy, 1 to 2 minutes.

Assemble cake: Place 1 cake layer on a serving platter; spread top with 1 cup frosting. Top with second layer and spread with 1 cup frosting. Top with third layer and spread remaining frosting over top and sides of cake. Arrange pecan halves on top of cake.
For a fancy finish, gently press 1/2 cup chopped toasted pecans around the sides of the frosted layer cake.

recipes.title: Kusherie (Egyptian Rice and Lentils)
steps: Sauté green lentils in olive oil. Add beef broth and salt and pepper to taste. Simmer 10 minutes, uncovered.
Add rice and broth or water. Simmer 20–25 minutes, covered.
For sauce, mix tomato paste, cumin, tomato sauce, and cayenne pepper and simmer.

recipes.title: Hashbrown Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom or cream of chicken soup
steps: Mix together and pour into a 9 × 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
ingredients: 1 cup unsalted butter, at room temperature
steps: Heat oven to 350°F. Grease and flour a 9 × 5-inch loaf pan.
In a large mixer on medium-high speed, beat butter until light and fluffy. Add sugar and beat until well combined and mixture is smooth.
Reduce speed to medium; add vanilla, then eggs, one at a time, beating and scraping down the bowl after each addition.
Reduce speed to low and add flour and salt, mixing until just combined. Pour batter into prepared pan.
Bake 1 hour, or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan 10 minutes, then turn cake onto a wire rack and cool completely.

recipes.title: Chocolate Bliss Cheesecake
ingredients: 3 packages (8 ounces each) cream cheese, softened
1 package (8 squares) Baker’s semisweet baking chocolate, melted and cooled slightly
steps: Heat oven to 325°F. Mix crushed cookies and butter; press onto bottom of a 9-inch springform pan. Bake 10 minutes.
Mix cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla with mixer on medium speed until well blended. Add eggs, mixing on low speed just until blended. Blend in melted chocolate. Pour over crust.
Bake 55–60 minutes or until center is almost set. Run knife or metal spatula around rim of pan to loosen cake; cool before removing rim of pan. Refrigerate 4 hours or overnight.

recipes.title: All American Brownies
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F. Lightly coat an 8 × 8 × 2-inch baking pan with butter, dust with flour, and set aside.
Melt butter and chocolates in the microwave or a double boiler. In a large bowl, using a hand whisk, beat eggs and sugar together until combined. Stir in vanilla and salt.
Add chocolate mixture and stir until just combined. Stir in flour and nuts. Spread batter evenly in prepared pan.
Bake on middle shelf of oven for 35–40 minutes. Cool in pan.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups oil (or 1/2 cup oil and 1/2 cup applesauce)
steps: Beat first three ingredients together. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 350°F for 35 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Decorator Icing
steps: Put all ingredients in a bowl and beat for 5 minutes. For a really creamy effect, add more milk and beat 5 more minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Icing
steps: Cream butter and cocoa. Add powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla. Beat until creamy.

recipes.title: Welcome Home Bars
steps: In a 13 × 9-inch pan, melt margarine in a 350°F oven. Sprinkle crumbs over margarine, pour milk over crumbs, and chips over milk.
Press down firmly and bake for 25–30 minutes until lightly browned. Let cool and cut.

recipes.title: Kiss Cookies
steps: Beat until very light, then add dry ingredients. Form into balls. Roll in sugar and bake at 375°F for 8 minutes.
Put a chocolate kiss in the middle and bake for 2–5 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
steps: Cream margarine, brown sugar, Equal, egg, and vanilla; stir in dry ingredients, then raisins.
Drop by spoonfuls onto baking sheet and bake at 375°F for 8–10 minutes.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Pumpkin Pie
steps: Beat ingredients. Pour into pie shell and bake at 425°F for 15 minutes and at 350°F for 45 minutes or until a knife inserted comes out clean.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pudding Cake
ingredients: 4 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted and cooled
steps: Sift flour, 1/3 cup cocoa, baking powder, and salt. Set aside.
In a medium bowl, whisk eggs, sugar, milk, butter, and vanilla. Add to flour mixture and stir until just combined.
Spread evenly into baking dish. Set aside.
In a medium bowl, whisk 1/3 cup cocoa, brown sugar, and boiling water. Pour evenly over batter.
Bake at 350°F for 40 minutes, until a cake tester comes out with crumbs sticking to it.
Cool 10 minutes. May serve warm with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Angel Hair Pasta with Chicken
ingredients: 2 packages (10 ounces each) frozen broccoli, thawed
steps: Cook chicken in 2 tablespoons olive oil until done, about 5 minutes. Remove and drain on paper towels.
Heat remaining oil and add carrots; cook 4 minutes.
Add broccoli and garlic, cooking together for 2 minutes.
Add broth, basil, and cheese to skillet and stir. Return chicken to skillet.
Reduce heat and simmer 4 minutes. Serve over pasta.

recipes.title: Broccoli and Garlic Pasta
ingredients: 2 packages (10 ounces each) broccoli spears, thawed
steps: Over medium heat, cook garlic in oil 1 minute. Stir in tomatoes and cook 5 minutes or until softened.
Add broccoli and 1 teaspoon each salt and pepper; heat through.
Drain pasta, reserving 1/4 cup liquid. Add pasta and liquid to pan; toss well to coat.

recipes.title: Lemony Oven Fries
ingredients: 1 package (20 ounces) frozen French-fried shoestring potatoes, about 5 cups
steps: In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Carefully add lemon slices. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes or until lemon begins to brown. Use tongs to turn lemon slices.
Add parsley to the oil. Cook for 20 to 30 seconds more or until parsley is crisp.
Remove lemon slices and parsley with a slotted spoon; drain on paper towels. Reserve the lemon-flavored oil; you should have about 3 tablespoons.
In a large bowl, toss frozen shoestring potatoes with reserved oil until well coated. Place potatoes in a 15 × 10 × 1-inch baking pan.
Bake according to package directions or until potatoes are browned and crisp, stirring occasionally.
To serve, toss lemon and parsley with hot potatoes. Sprinkle generously with sea salt. Squeeze lemon wedges over fries. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Wizard’s Blood
steps: Slice apple for garnish.

recipes.title: The Godiva Truffletini
steps: Place ice in a cocktail shaker. Add the chocolate and white chocolate liqueurs to the vodka. Shake vigorously until well blended.
Strain into a chilled martini glass and garnish with chocolate shavings.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Key Lime Pie
steps: Bake at 350°F for 5–8 minutes until pinhole bubbles form.
Chill. Garnish with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Whole-Grain Nut Bread
steps: Combine wheat germ, oats, walnuts, sunflower seeds, and flax seeds. Cut dough into 1-inch pieces. Combine with nut mixture and knead together.
Form into an 8-inch round and place on a greased baking sheet. Loosely cover and let rise about 1 hour. Bake at 375°F until cooked through, 25–30 minutes.

recipes.title: Famous Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (1 can or 12 fluid ounces) Carnation Evaporated Milk
steps: Mix dry ingredients in a small bowl. Beat eggs in a large bowl. Stir in pumpkin and dry ingredient mixture. Gradually stir in milk or milks.
Pour into pie shell.

Bake in a preheated 425°F oven for 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350°F; bake for 30–40 minutes or until a knife inserted near center comes out clean. Cool on a wire rack for 2 hours. Serve immediately or refrigerate.

Printed variations: For Chai Spice Pumpkin Pie, add an additional 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg, 1 teaspoon ground cardamom, 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon, and 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger. For Bourbon Pumpkin Pie, add 2 tablespoons bourbon when adding milk.

recipes.title: New Fashioned Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups (1 can or 14 ounces) Carnation or La Lechera Sweetened Condensed Milk
steps: Mix dry ingredients in a small bowl. Beat eggs in a large bowl. Stir in pumpkin and dry ingredient mixture. Gradually stir in milk or milks.
Pour into pie shell.

Bake in a preheated 425°F oven for 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350°F; bake for 30–40 minutes or until a knife inserted near center comes out clean. Cool on a wire rack for 2 hours. Serve immediately or refrigerate.

Printed variations: For Chai Spice Pumpkin Pie, add an additional 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg, 1 teaspoon ground cardamom, 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon, and 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger. For Bourbon Pumpkin Pie, add 2 tablespoons bourbon when adding milk.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Bake at 325°F for 60–75 minutes.

recipes.title: Candied Pecans
steps: Mix dry ingredients in a bowl. Whisk egg white and water until frothy. Toss pecans in egg whites.
Mix with sugar mixture until coated. Spread on a baking sheet. Bake at 250°F for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cranberry–Poppy Seed Ring
steps: Beat together cream cheese and sugar; stir in cranberries, poppy seeds, and lemon zest.

Roll dough into a 10 × 14-inch rectangle. Spread with cream cheese mixture, leaving a 1-inch border along one long edge. Start at the long edge without the border and roll into a tight log; pinch seams together to seal.

Transfer to a greased baking sheet and form into a ring; pinch together where ends meet. With kitchen shears, snip outside edge of ring, cutting almost all the way through at 1 1/2-inch intervals, making 12 slices. Gently twist each slice so the inside is visible. Loosely cover and let rise about 1 hour.
Brush with egg wash if desired and bake at 375°F about 35 minutes. Cool on pan and drizzle with icing.

recipes.title: Orange Blossom Punch
ingredients: 1 can (10 ounces) frozen strawberry or peach daiquiri mix concentrate, thawed
1 bottle (750 milliliters) sparkling white grape juice, chilled
Strawberries and orange wedges, for garnish
steps: Combine orange juice, thawed concentrate, and water; stir. Add sparkling grape juice; do not stir. Garnish with strawberries and orange wedges.

recipes.title: Molten Chocolate Cakes
ingredients: 1/4 cup granulated sugar, plus additional for dusting
1/2 cup butter or margarine (1 stick), cut into pieces
Whipped cream or vanilla ice cream, optional
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Grease eight 6-ounce custard cups and dust with granulated sugar.

In a heavy 3-quart saucepan, heat chocolate, butter, and cream over low heat, stirring occasionally, until chocolate melts and mixture is smooth. Remove from heat; add vanilla. Whisk in flour until smooth.

In a medium bowl, beat 1/4 cup granulated sugar, eggs, and yolks with a mixer at high speed until thick and lemon-colored, about 10 minutes. Fold egg mixture into chocolate mixture one-third at a time until blended.

Divide batter evenly among cups. If making ahead, wrap well and refrigerate up to 24 hours or freeze up to 2 weeks. Place cups in a jelly-roll pan. Bake 8–10 minutes, until edges are set and centers still jiggle; bake frozen cakes for 16 minutes.

Cool in pan on a wire rack 3 minutes. Run a thin knife around cups to loosen cakes and invert onto plates. Dust with confectioners’ sugar. Serve immediately with whipped cream or ice cream if desired.

recipes.title: Apple Crumble
ingredients: 4 large apples, such as Granny Smith
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Grease a 2-quart baking dish.
For topping, mix flour, rolled oats, granulated sugar, and butter in a large bowl.
Peel, core, and slice apples; layer in prepared dish. Sprinkle brown sugar and cinnamon over apples, then sprinkle topping mixture over them.
Bake 20–25 minutes, until apples soften and crumble is lightly golden. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Our Best White Cake
ingredients: 7 large egg whites, at room temperature
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Lightly grease three 8-inch round cake pans with cooking spray. Line bottoms with parchment paper rounds and spray paper.

Beat butter and sugar in a heavy-duty stand mixer with paddle attachment on medium-high speed 3–5 minutes, until creamy and fluffy. Stop and scrape sides. With mixer on low, add egg whites one at a time, scraping sides as needed. Add extracts and beat on low just until combined.

Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl. Add to egg mixture alternately with milk in three parts, beginning and ending with flour mixture. Beat until blended after each addition. Divide among pans.

Bake 24–26 minutes, until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean and edges begin pulling away from pans. Cool in pans on wire racks 15 minutes. Invert onto racks, remove pans, and cool completely before frosting, 30 minutes. Alternatively, wrap in plastic and freeze 2 hours or refrigerate 4–6 hours before frosting.

For buttercream, beat butter in a heavy-duty stand mixer with paddle on medium 1–2 minutes until creamy. Reduce to low and gradually add powdered sugar, beating about 2 minutes until smooth and scraping sides as needed. Beat in vanilla and salt. With mixer on medium, gradually add cream and beat about 30 seconds until fluffy and spreadable.

Place one layer on a serving plate or cake stand. Put about half of buttercream in a 16-inch disposable piping bag and cut a 1/2-inch opening in tip. Pipe buttercream 1/3 inch high in concentric circles from outside inward. Add second layer and repeat, refilling bag as needed. Add third layer and repeat. Generously cover cake with buttercream using an offset spatula. Drag spatula around sides starting at bottom; smooth top.
Insert rosemary into cake top, dust with powdered sugar, and top with cookies.

recipes.title: Gingerbread Cookies
ingredients: 5 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, plus more for work surface
steps: Beat butter and sugar with a heavy-duty electric stand mixer on medium about 3 minutes until fluffy; set aside.
Stir baking soda and hot water in a bowl until dissolved; stir in molasses.

Stir flour, ginger, cinnamon, salt, and allspice in a large bowl. Add flour mixture to butter mixture alternately with molasses mixture in three parts, beginning and ending with flour. Beat on medium until incorporated after each addition. Shape into a flat disk, wrap in plastic, and chill 1 hour.

Preheat oven to 350°F. Roll dough 1/8 inch thick on a lightly floured surface. Cut with 3- and 4-inch cookie cutters; gather and reroll scraps as desired. Place 2 inches apart on parchment-lined baking sheets. Bake 15–18 minutes until edges are lightly browned. Cool on sheets 2 minutes, then transfer to racks and cool completely, 30 minutes.

For royal icing, beat powdered sugar, meringue powder, and 6 tablespoons warm water with an electric mixer on low 1 minute until blended. Increase to medium and beat 2 minutes until smooth. Add remaining warm water 1/4 teaspoon at a time to desired consistency.
Spoon icing into a small zip-top plastic freezer bag with one corner snipped; pipe on cookies.

recipes.title: Hershey’s Best Loved Chocolate Cheesecake
recipes.time: 10 minutes + 40 minutes + 30 seconds, with additional 15-second intervals as needed
ingredients: 2 teaspoons shortening (do not use butter, margarine, spread, or oil)
steps: For crust, combine chocolate wafer crumbs and butter or margarine; press onto bottom of a 9-inch springform pan. Heat oven to 450°F.
Beat cream cheese and sugar until blended. Beat in sour cream and vanilla, then cocoa and flour. Add eggs one at a time and beat just until blended. Pour into crust.
Bake 10 minutes. Reduce oven to 250°F and bake 40 minutes more. Remove to a wire rack. Loosen cake from side of pan with a knife. Cool completely and remove side of pan.

For drizzle, put chocolate chips and shortening in a small microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on high (100%) for 30 seconds. If needed, heat on high 15 seconds at a time, stirring after each, just until melted. Drizzle over cake.
Refrigerate 4–6 hours. Store covered in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Fresh Strawberry Truffles
ingredients: 2 1/3 cups (14 ounces) white chocolate chips (from two 11-ounce packages)
steps: Process strawberries in a food processor or blender about 30 seconds until smooth, scraping sides as needed. Pour through a fine-mesh strainer into a small bowl, pressing pulp with a spoon to release juices; discard pulp. Measure 1/4 cup strawberry purée.

Combine white chocolate chips, cream, and 1/4 cup strawberry purée in a medium heatproof bowl. Microwave on high in 15-second intervals, stirring after each, until melted and thick, about 45–60 seconds total. Stir in lemon zest and salt; add food coloring if desired. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm, about 1 1/2–2 hours.

Mix pink and white sanding sugars in a shallow dish. Scoop chilled mixture into 24 portions using the large side of a melon baller or a small cookie scoop about 1 1/4 inches in diameter. Roll each portion into a ball with hands, then gently toss in sugar mixture to coat. Place on a parchment-lined baking sheet.

Serve immediately or store airtight in refrigerator up to 1 week or freezer up to 2 months. Let chilled truffles stand at room temperature 30 minutes before serving; thaw frozen truffles overnight in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Tipsy Strawberry Truffles
ingredients: 2 1/3 cups (14 ounces) white chocolate chips (from two 11-ounce packages)
1 tablespoon brandy and 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract
1/4 cup freeze-dried strawberries, finely chopped in a food processor (from one 0.8-ounce package)
steps: Process strawberries in a food processor or blender about 30 seconds until smooth, scraping sides as needed. Pour through a fine-mesh strainer into a small bowl, pressing pulp with a spoon to release juices; discard pulp. Measure 1/4 cup strawberry purée.

Combine white chocolate chips, cream, and 1/4 cup strawberry purée in a medium heatproof bowl. Microwave on high in 15-second intervals, stirring after each, until melted and thick, about 45–60 seconds total. Stir in brandy, vanilla extract, and salt; add food coloring if desired. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm, about 1 1/2–2 hours.

Place finely chopped freeze-dried strawberries in a shallow dish. Scoop chilled mixture into 24 portions using the large side of a melon baller or a small cookie scoop about 1 1/4 inches in diameter. Roll each portion into a ball with hands, then gently toss in chopped strawberries to coat. Place on a parchment-lined baking sheet.

Serve immediately or store airtight in refrigerator up to 1 week or freezer up to 2 months. Let chilled truffles stand at room temperature 30 minutes before serving; thaw frozen truffles overnight in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Strawberry-Coconut Truffles
ingredients: 2 1/3 cups (14 ounces) white chocolate chips (from two 11-ounce packages)
1 1/4 cups finely chopped sweetened flaked coconut
steps: Process strawberries in a food processor or blender about 30 seconds until smooth, scraping sides as needed. Pour through a fine-mesh strainer into a small bowl, pressing pulp with a spoon to release juices; discard pulp. Measure 1/4 cup strawberry purée.

Combine white chocolate chips, cream, and 1/4 cup strawberry purée in a medium heatproof bowl. Microwave on high in 15-second intervals, stirring after each, until melted and thick, about 45–60 seconds total. Stir in coconut extract and salt; add food coloring if desired. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm, about 1 1/2–2 hours.

Place finely chopped coconut in a shallow dish. Scoop chilled mixture into 24 portions using the large side of a melon baller or a small cookie scoop about 1 1/4 inches in diameter. Roll each portion into a ball with hands, then gently toss in coconut to coat. Place on a parchment-lined baking sheet.

Serve immediately or store airtight in refrigerator up to 1 week or freezer up to 2 months. Let chilled truffles stand at room temperature 30 minutes before serving; thaw frozen truffles overnight in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Creamy Strawberry-Vanilla Bean Truffles
ingredients: 2 1/3 cups (14 ounces) white chocolate chips (from two 11-ounce packages)
steps: Process strawberries in a food processor or blender about 30 seconds until smooth, scraping sides as needed. Pour through a fine-mesh strainer into a small bowl, pressing pulp with a spoon to release juices; discard pulp. Measure 1/4 cup strawberry purée.

Combine white chocolate chips, cream, and 1/4 cup strawberry purée in a medium heatproof bowl. Microwave on high in 15-second intervals, stirring after each, until melted and thick, about 45–60 seconds total. Stir in vanilla bean paste and salt; add food coloring if desired. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm, about 1 1/2–2 hours.
Scoop and roll chilled mixture into 24 balls as directed for Fresh Strawberry Truffles.

Microwave the additional 11-ounce package white chocolate chips in a medium heatproof bowl on high in 30-second intervals, stirring after each, until melted, about 1 minute total. Reserve 2 tablespoons melted chocolate in a bowl. Dip each truffle into remaining chocolate with a fork, coat fully, and allow excess to drip off. Place on a parchment-lined baking sheet.

Stir red liquid food coloring into reserved chocolate to desired color. Drizzle pink mixture over dipped truffles with a fork, or pipe from a small zip-top freezer bag with a hole cut in one corner. Let stand at room temperature about 15 minutes until chocolate sets.

recipes.title: ‘Biscuits with the Boss’ Shortbread
ingredients: 1 cup unsalted butter, softened and cut into pieces, plus more for greasing
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Butter a 9-inch square baking pan. Line bottom and sides with parchment paper, leaving a 1-inch overhang on all sides. Set aside.
Beat butter, flour, sugar, vanilla, and salt with a paddle-fitted stand mixer on low until well combined and just coming together, 45 seconds to 1 minute.
Press dough evenly into pan with hands. If too sticky, cover dough with parchment paper and press into pan; remove that parchment before baking.
Bake 30–35 minutes until edges are golden brown. Cool completely in pan about 1 hour. Lift out using parchment handles and cut into 18 rectangles.

recipes.title: Black Magic Punch
ingredients: 1 bottle (750 milliliters) dark dry red wine
1 cup blackberries, plus more for garnish
steps: Mix wine, fruit juice, brandy, liqueur, blackberries, grapes, and plums in a large pitcher. Chill 1–2 hours.
Pour into glasses and garnish with blackberries and orange twists.

recipes.title: Apple Pie Filling
steps: Melt butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add sugars, vanilla, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Fold in apples. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid boils.
Mix cornstarch with water and stir into boiling apples. Cook 5 minutes. Let cool before filling pie shell.

recipes.title: Yeast Rolls
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Mix water, yeast, and sugar in a large mixing bowl until yeast starts to bubble. Mix remaining ingredients until a soft dough forms; knead until smooth.
Put in a greased bowl and let rise approximately 1 hour. Punch down and shape into 12 rolls. Place in a greased 9 × 13-inch pan and let rise again about 30 minutes.
Bake 20 minutes and brush with butter.

recipes.title: Baked Oatmeal
ingredients: 1/3 cup sugar or maple syrup, plus more for serving
1 1/2 cups fresh or frozen blueberries, huckleberries, or mixed berries
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F with rack in top third of oven. Butter an 8 × 8-inch baking pan.
Mix oats, half the walnuts, sugar if using, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt in a bowl. In another bowl, whisk maple syrup if using, milk, egg, half the butter, and vanilla.

Arrange bananas in a single layer in pan. Sprinkle two-thirds of berries over them. Cover with oat mixture. Slowly drizzle milk mixture over oats. Gently tap baking dish on countertop a few times to move milk through oats. Scatter remaining berries and walnuts on top.
Bake 35–45 minutes, until top is golden and oats are set. Remove and drizzle remaining melted butter on top. Serve with extra sugar or syrup.

recipes.title: Spinach Tomato Tortellini Soup
ingredients: 1 can (14.5 ounces) petite diced tomatoes, undrained
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
steps: Heat olive oil in a large stockpot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add garlic and onion; cook, stirring frequently, until onion is translucent, about 2–3 minutes.
Whisk in broth, tomatoes, tortellini, basil, oregano, bay leaf, and water. Season with salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer until tortellini is cooked, about 5–6 minutes. Stir in spinach until it starts to wilt, about 2 minutes.
Serve immediately, garnished with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Bisquick Substitute
steps: Sift flour into a bowl. Add baking powder and salt and whisk until fully incorporated. Cut butter into flour mixture with a pastry cutter until evenly combined.
Shortening or oil may replace butter if desired. If using melted butter, disperse it as evenly as possible.

recipes.title: Glazed Squash Cubes
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds butternut squash, peeled, seeded, and cut in 3/4-inch cubes
1 teaspoon finely shredded blood orange peel or orange peel
1/2 cup blood orange juice or orange juice
2 scallions or green onions, finely chopped
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Place squash cubes in a lightly greased 13 × 9 × 2-inch baking pan.
Combine orange peel, orange juice, scallions, soy sauce, brown sugar, and chili oil in a bowl. Drizzle over squash and toss to coat.
Roast uncovered 20–25 minutes or until squash is tender, stirring twice. Stir again before serving. Place a toothpick in each cube and serve warm.

recipes.title: Black Bean Salsa
ingredients: 2 cans (15.5 ounces each) black beans, rinsed
steps: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Filled-Up Phyllo Logs
ingredients: 2 cups finely diced cremini and/or shiitake mushrooms
steps: For spinach–white bean filling, thaw spinach, drain thoroughly, finely chop, and set aside. Drain beans, rinse, and drain again. Process beans, garlic, and water in a food processor or blender until smooth. Transfer to a medium bowl, add spinach, and mix well.

For mushroom–onion filling, heat oil in a large skillet until hot. Cook mushrooms, onion, and garlic over medium-high heat for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are tender and liquid evaporates.

Preheat oven to 375°F. Lightly brush a phyllo sheet with butter. Top with another sheet and brush with butter. Keep remaining dough covered with plastic wrap. Cut stacked sheets in half lengthwise and then crosswise to make four equal rectangles.

Spread about 2 tablespoons bean filling in a 3/4-inch-wide strip along one long side of each rectangle, leaving 1 inch at short ends. Roll tightly into a thin log from filled side. Brush seam with butter. Place seam down on a baking sheet, brush with butter, and sprinkle with Parmesan. Repeat with remaining bean filling and four more phyllo sheets.

Fill remaining six sheets with mushroom–onion filling by the same procedure, using 4 teaspoons filling per log and sprinkling logs with ground pepper. Bake 18 minutes or until golden brown. Tie ends with chive strands.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
steps: Cream mayonnaise and cream cheese for first layer. Add sour cream as second layer and taco sauce as third layer. Add shredded lettuce, tomatoes, olives, and cheese. Serve with nacho chips for dipping.

recipes.title: Horseradish-Radish Sandwich
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups herbed goat cheese (chèvre) or 2 containers (5 ounces each) semisoft cheese with garlic and herbs
1 package (17 1/4 ounces) frozen puff pastry (2 sheets), thawed
1 large English cucumber, very thinly sliced
steps: In a medium bowl, combine cheese, green onion, and horseradish. Cover and chill until ready to use.

Preheat oven to 375°F. Unfold one pastry sheet on a lightly floured surface. Generously prick pastry with fork tines. Cut into circles using a 2-inch round cutter. Transfer to an ungreased baking sheet.
Brush pastry lightly with milk. Sprinkle with salt. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack. Repeat with remaining pastry sheet.

Split baked pastries horizontally with a knife. Spread about 1 teaspoon cheese mixture on cut side of each bottom pastry. Top with several cucumber and radish slices. Spread cut side of each top pastry with about 1 teaspoon cheese mixture. Place on top of radish slices.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 package Knorr dry vegetable soup mix
steps: Thaw and squeeze spinach.
Stir together sour cream, mayonnaise, soup mix, and green onions. Blend all ingredients well, cover, and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Caesar Salad Cracker Cups
ingredients: 2 to 3 tablespoons bottled Caesar salad dressing
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. In a medium bowl, stir together flours, sugar, baking soda, salt, and pepper. Cut in butter with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in shredded Parmesan cheese and garlic.
Make a well in center of flour mixture. Add buttermilk. Stir with a fork until mixture can be shaped into a ball.

Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface. Knead 8 to 10 strokes or until almost smooth. Divide dough in half. Roll each portion into a 12 × 9-inch rectangle. Cut into 3 × 3-inch squares using a pastry wheel or knife. Prick squares several times with a fork.

Coat bottom side of a mini muffin pan with nonstick cooking spray. Lay dough squares over muffin cup bottoms without overlapping edges. Place inverted muffin pan on a shallow baking sheet. Bake about 10 minutes or until golden brown. Remove cracker cups and cool on a wire rack. May be made up to 3 days ahead.

Toss romaine with salad dressing in a medium bowl. To serve, sprinkle some chopped egg into each cracker cup. Fill with romaine mixture and sprinkle with shaved Parmesan cheese. May also top with roasted beets.

recipes.title: Roasted Beets
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Scrub beet; trim off stem and root ends. Peel and cut into 3/4-inch pieces. Place in an 8 × 8 × 2-inch baking pan.
In a small bowl, combine olive oil, garlic, balsamic vinegar, salt, and pepper. Drizzle over beets and toss lightly to coat.
Cover pan with foil and roast 35 minutes. Uncover and roast 10 minutes more or until beets are tender. Cool to room temperature.

recipes.title: Devil’s Salsa
ingredients: 1 can (15 ounces) black beans, rinsed and drained
1 yellow or orange pepper, roasted and diced
steps: Coat baking sheet with oil and roast corn at 450°F for 10 minutes.
Mix together all ingredients and let stand at room temperature for at least 1 hour.

recipes.title: Tortilla Chips
steps: Mix olive oil, chili powder, and cayenne. Brush tops of flour tortillas, stack, and cut into wedges.
Place on baking sheets, sprinkle with salt, and bake at 350°F for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Honey-Whole Wheat Bread
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients and add warm water. Beat on low speed 1 minute, then medium speed 1 minute.
Stir in regular flour, 1 cup at a time, to make dough easy to handle. Knead until smooth and elastic.
Place in a greased bowl and cover; let rise until doubled. Punch down and divide into greased bread pans. Let rise until doubled.
Bake at 375°F for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple-Blueberry Bread
ingredients: 1/2 to 1 cup fresh blueberries or dry-pack frozen blueberries
steps: Grease and flour loaf pan. Beat together margarine, sugar, eggs, and applesauce, then dry ingredients until blended.
Fold in blueberries. Spread into pan. Bake at 350°F for 55 to 60 minutes or until bread tests done.
Cool 10 minutes in pan before removing.
For apple raisin bread, substitute 1 cup raisins for blueberries.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
ingredients: 1 cup dates (or nuts or raisins, as mentioned in method)
steps: Mix all ingredients except dates until blended. Add dates, nuts, or raisins.
Pour into greased bread pans. Bake at 350°F for 30 to 45 minutes, until a pick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Cinnamon-Raisin Bread
steps: Sprinkle yeast over 1/2 cup warm water; set aside.
Combine 5 cups flour, salt, and sugar minus 2 tablespoons. Add yeast mixture, remaining water, and butter all at once. Knead to form a ball. Use remaining flour and knead 3 to 5 minutes.
Grease a large bowl and let dough rise until doubled. Punch down and roll out. Brush top with water.
Mix cinnamon with reserved 2 tablespoons sugar and sprinkle over dough. Top with raisins. Roll up jelly-roll style and put into a greased loaf pan, seam side down.
Let rise until doubled. Bake at 350°F until it sounds hollow.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs, then remaining ingredients.
Pour into greased bread pans and bake at 350°F for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Honey Oat Bread
steps: Combine dry ingredients. Make a well in center.
In a separate bowl, whisk milk, honey, and egg. Add to dry mixture; stir until blended.
Pour into greased bread pan. Bake at 350°F for 50 minutes or until a pick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Sweet Rolls
steps: Dissolve yeast in water with sugar. Add half the flour, shortening, salt, and egg; blend well. Add remaining flour.
Let dough rise until doubled, about 45 minutes. Roll onto a floured board and shape into 1-inch balls. Put 3 balls per muffin tin.
Bake at 350°F until golden brown.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Honey Bread
ingredients: 7 cups flour (2 to 3 cups whole wheat)
steps: Mix water, sugar, and yeast; set aside until risen and bubbly.
Mix all ingredients together and knead until smooth and elastic. Place in a well-greased bowl. Let rise until doubled.
Punch down and divide into 2 or 3 greased loaf pans. Let rise until doubled. Bake at 375°F for 35 to 45 minutes.
Can also be made into dinner rolls.

recipes.title: Cranberry-Nut Bread
steps: Mix together dry ingredients. Add remaining ingredients except cranberries and nuts. Mix well.
Stir in cranberries and nuts. Pour into loaf pan. Bake at 350°F for 55 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in pan 15 minutes, then remove.

recipes.title: Easter Morning Biscuits
steps: Sift flour, baking powder, and salt into a medium bowl. With an electric mixer, combine butter, 1/3 cup honey, and sugar in a large bowl until light and fluffy.
With mixer running, add eggs one at a time until thoroughly incorporated. Add milk, vanilla, and 2 tablespoons orange juice. Beat on medium speed until combined.
Gradually add flour mixture until all flour is incorporated and a soft dough forms. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate dough 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350°F. In a small bowl, combine remaining honey and orange juice. Stir glaze until smooth and set aside.
Divide dough into 16 equal pieces. Form each into an “S” shape or a twist. Place biscuits on a baking sheet and bake 12 minutes.
Remove and brush with orange glaze. Continue baking until golden, about 15 more minutes. Cool on a wire rack.

recipes.title: Tomato Salad
steps: Cut tomatoes into wedges; toss all ingredients together. Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Zucchini-Tomato Saute
steps: Sauté onions in olive oil over medium-high heat. Add zucchini, salt, and pepper; cook 3 minutes.
Add tomatoes and sauté an additional 4 minutes. Stir in dill.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
steps: Mix together and pour into a greased 9 × 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350°F for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Risi e Bisi (Italian Rice and Pea Soup)
recipes.time: 8 to 10 minutes + 1 minute + 5 minutes + 20 minutes + 12 to 14 minutes
ingredients: 1 pound fresh peas, shelled and blanched, or 1 cup frozen peas
steps: In a large Dutch oven over medium heat, add olive oil and butter. Sauté onion 8 to 10 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute. Add celery, peas, salt, and pepper; cook 5 minutes more, stirring occasionally.
Stir in chicken broth; simmer 20 minutes. Add rice and cook 12 to 14 minutes, stirring occasionally. Test for doneness.
Stir in Parmesan cheese and serve.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
steps: Spread on cooled crust and top with raw vegetables.

recipes.title: Slum Gullian Stew
steps: Parboil green pepper, celery, potatoes, and onions.
Mix tomato soup with water from vegetables. Add kidney beans, ground beef, and vegetables.
Simmer until vegetables are soft.

recipes.title: Easy Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 can (4 ounces) mushrooms, optional, or substitute 1/2 cup water
steps: Add dry onion soup mix to browned beef. Add mushrooms if desired, or substitute 1/2 cup water. Add parsley.
Cook together, then add sour cream. Serve over egg noodles.

recipes.title: Chicken Piccata
steps: Pound chicken flat between plastic wrap. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in skillet over high heat. Brown breasts 2 minutes on each side, then place in a warm oven.
For sauce, reheat skillet over medium heat. Add wine and reduce 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Stir in capers and lemon juice.
Remove from heat, add butter, and stir until melted.

recipes.title: Whole-Wheat Penne Pasta with Greens, Beans and Feta
ingredients: 4 cans (14 1/2 ounces each) diced tomatoes, seasoned with basil, garlic, and oregano
2 cans (19 ounces each) cannellini beans, drained
steps: Heat oil in a saucepan. Add garlic and sauté 1 minute.
Stir in tomatoes and beans; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes.
Add spinach and cook until just wilted. Cover and keep warm. Toss with cooked pasta.

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
ingredients: 1 can (15 ounces) chili beans or kidney beans
2 cups dry elbow macaroni or rice
steps: Brown ground beef. Combine ingredients in a 9 × 13-inch baking dish. Start with 2 cups water and add more as needed until pasta or rice is done.
Bake at 350°F for 40 minutes or until pasta or rice is done.
Add grated cheddar cheese about 15 minutes before serving. Top with nacho chips, shredded lettuce, sour cream, olives, and other desired toppings.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Mexican Rice and Bean Casserole
steps: Spray a large skillet with cooking spray. Heat over medium heat until hot. Add rice and cook 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden brown.
In a slow cooker, combine rice and remaining ingredients except cheese. Cook on low 5 hours, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle with cheese before serving.
recipes.notes: 1 can beans. The skillet-spraying and rice-browning instruction is crossed out.

recipes.title: Heart Healthy Fettuccine Alfredo
ingredients: 2 cups well-cooked cannellini, great northern, or white beans (fill cups with beans and add cooking liquid to top of cup)
1/4 cup grated low-fat Pecorino Romano cheese or soy vegetable Parmesan
1 cup dried tomatoes, rehydrated by soaking in boiling water 20 seconds, drained, cooled, and sliced into thin strips
steps: Begin heating a large pot of water for pasta. In a blender, purée beans, milk, garlic powder, salt, and nutmeg until very smooth and creamy.
When water boils, add fettuccini pasta to salted water. As pasta begins cooking, heat bean and milk mixture in a medium pot, stirring occasionally, to just below simmering.
Remove sauce from burner and stir in grated cheese. Adjust seasoning if desired.
If desired, add broccoli to cooking pasta for its last couple of minutes.

recipes.title: Quiche
steps: Combine ingredients and pour into pie shell.
Bake 7 minutes at 450°F, then 35 to 40 minutes at 350°F.

recipes.title: Lasagne
ingredients: Sliced or shredded provolone and mozzarella cheese
steps: Layer with noodles in a 9 × 13-inch baking dish.
Bake at 375°F for 30 to 45 minutes or until bubbly.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Taco Salad
ingredients: Water for soaking and cooking beans
Cheese, sour cream, lettuce, and other toppings
steps: Rinse and soak beans overnight. In the morning, rinse and cover with fresh water; cook until tender. Drain and set aside.
Put all together in a pan and simmer. Add additional tomato juice if needed.
Serve on a bed of tortilla chips topped with cheese, sour cream, lettuce, and other toppings.

recipes.title: White Beans, Greens, and Rosemary
ingredients: 8 cups packed kale leaves, stems discarded
1 can (15 ounces) cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Cook pasta according to package directions. When almost tender, add kale and cook 1 minute or until pasta and kale are tender; drain.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic, rosemary, and red pepper; cook 2 minutes or until spices are fragrant.
Add beans; cook 2 minutes or until thoroughly heated.
Combine pasta mixture, bean mixture, and remaining ingredients; toss well.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
steps: Mix together and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Whole-Wheat Pasta Shells with Spicy Tomato Pesto and Winter Greens
ingredients: 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes, packed without oil
3 cups trimmed Swiss chard, sliced into 1/2-inch strips
8 cups hot cooked whole-wheat pasta shells (4 cups uncooked)
steps: For pesto, combine boiling water and sun-dried tomatoes in a bowl; let stand 30 minutes or until soft. Drain in a colander over a bowl, reserving 1/2 cup liquid.

With food processor running, drop tomatoes, almonds, cheese, basil, and garlic through food chute; process until minced. Keep processor running and add salt and red pepper. Slowly pour 1 1/2 tablespoons oil through chute; process until well blended, scraping sides.
Add reserved soaking liquid 1 tablespoon at a time until mixture appears smooth. Set aside.
For greens, heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion; cook 10 minutes or until lightly browned, stirring frequently.
Add Swiss chard; stir-fry 1 minute or until leaves turn bright green. Add water, salt, and pepper; cover and cook 2 minutes.
Combine pesto and hot cooked pasta in a large bowl; toss well. Add greens mixture; toss well. Sprinkle with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Tortellini and Veggies
ingredients: 1 medium red sweet pepper, cut into 3/4-inch pieces (3/4 cup)
4 small zucchini, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/2-inch-thick slices
1/2 cup shredded Asiago or Parmesan cheese
steps: In a large skillet, cook onion, mushrooms, red sweet pepper, and garlic in hot oil over medium heat about 5 minutes or until onion is tender.
Stir in undrained tomatoes, tortellini, water, Italian seasoning, and black pepper. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Simmer, covered, 10 minutes.
Stir in zucchini. Cook, uncovered, 5 minutes more or until zucchini is crisp-tender.
Remove from heat. Sprinkle with cheese.

recipes.title: Grilled Chicken Burgers
ingredients: 2 tablespoons Dijon mustard and/or lemon mayonnaise
steps: In a bowl, combine lemon juice, olive oil, and pepper. Pour over chicken. Marinate 15 to 20 minutes at room temperature, turning occasionally to coat.
Grill chicken over hot coals 8 to 10 minutes on each side. Just before removing chicken, arrange buns over top of chicken to warm.
Place chicken, tomato, onion, and lettuce on bottom half of bun. Spread top half with Dijon mustard and/or lemon mayonnaise ingredients.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: Stir filling ingredients except pecans well, then add pecans. Stir and pour into pie shell.
Bake at 350°F for about 50 to 55 minutes, until a knife inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
steps: Mix filling ingredients together and pour into pie shells.
Bake at 425°F for 15 minutes, then lower oven to 350°F and bake 40 to 50 minutes or until a knife inserted into center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Double Fudge Pie
steps: For crust, mix dry ingredients. Cut in butter and shortening. Roll out to a 9-inch pie shell; trim and flute edges.
For filling, melt chocolate and butter; cool slightly. Stir in water and sugar. Beat in egg yolks and vanilla. Fold in flour and salt.
Beat egg whites in a bowl until soft peaks form. Fold in chocolate mixture and 1/2 cup walnuts.
Spread in pie shell; top with remaining nuts. Bake at 350°F for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
steps: Cook sugar, cornstarch, and water until thick. Remove from heat; add Jell-O and stir until dissolved.
Cool until lukewarm. Pour over berries in crust. Can also use peaches.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Pie
steps: Clean rhubarb, trim ends, and cut into 1-inch pieces.
In a large bowl, combine rhubarb, sugar, flour, and lemon rind. Set aside at least 15 minutes.
Put into pie shell and bake until filling is thick and bubbly.

recipes.title: Turtle Pie
steps: Melt caramels with 1/3 cup sweetened condensed milk in microwave. Pour into pie shell.
Mix remaining milk, eggs, vanilla, and water in a bowl. Melt chocolate and margarine; add to mixture.
Pour over caramel. Top with pecans and bake at 325°F for 35 minutes or until set.

recipes.title: Key Lime Pie
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream or whipping cream
steps: Mix crust ingredients and press into a 9-inch pie pan.
Whisk egg yolks and sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Gradually whisk in lime peel and lime juice until blended. Pour into crust.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°F. Cool 20 minutes.
Beat cream to soft peaks. Gradually beat in powdered sugar. Beat to stiff peaks. Spread over top of pie.

recipes.title: Summer Berry Pie
steps: Mix berries together and pour into pie shell.
Mix sugar and cornstarch in a medium saucepan. Gradually stir in water until smooth, stirring constantly. Cook over medium heat to a boil; boil 1 minute.
Remove from heat and stir in Jell-O until dissolved. Cool to room temperature. Pour over berries and refrigerate.
Spread with Cool Whip before serving.

recipes.title: Layer After Layer Lemon Pie
ingredients: 2 packages lemon instant pudding (4-serving size each)
steps: Spread jam on bottom of crust. Mix cream cheese with sugar until smooth. Gently stir in half the Cool Whip; spread over jam.
Pour milk into a large bowl and add pudding. Beat with a wire whisk until blended. Gently stir in remaining Cool Whip.
Spread over cream cheese layer. Refrigerate 4 hours.

recipes.title: Light and Fruity Pie
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add ice cubes and stir until thickened; remove any unmelted ice.
Using a whisk, blend in Cool Whip and whip until smooth. Fold in fruit. Chill if necessary until mixture will mound.
Spoon into pie crust. Chill 2 hours.

recipes.title: Cream Puffs
recipes.time: 15 minutes + 25 minutes + 20 minutes in turned-off oven
ingredients: 1 package Dream Whip, prepared according to package instructions
1 box instant vanilla pudding, prepared according to package instructions
steps: Mix water and margarine in a pan. Boil and add flour, beating rapidly. Remove from heat.
Cool slightly and add eggs one at a time, mixing well. Drop by heaping spoonfuls to desired size on baking sheet.
Bake at 450°F for 15 minutes, then 325°F for 25 minutes. Take out of oven, split in half, and return to turned-off oven 20 minutes.
Mix prepared Dream Whip and prepared pudding together. Fill puffs and drizzle tops with chocolate syrup.

recipes.title: Crepes
steps: Beat together until smooth. Pour 1/4 cup batter into a crêpe pan. Cook on both sides.

recipes.title: Popcorn Balls
steps: Cook syrup ingredients to medium crack, 280°F.
Before pouring over popcorn, add vanilla. Form into balls with greased hands.

recipes.title: Nut Rolls
ingredients: 4 cups flour, plus more as needed
1/4 cup milk, plus more to make spreadable
steps: Mix yeast, 1 teaspoon sugar, and warm water; let stand about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, blend margarine, 2 heaping tablespoons sugar, and salt until smooth. Add 3 egg yolks, 1 whole egg slightly beaten, and sour cream. Mix well.
Add 4 cups flour, 1 cup at a time. After third cup, add yeast mixture. Knead dough 10 to 15 minutes, adding more flour as needed.
Separate into 4 balls. Cover and let rise 10 minutes. Fill and roll up, tucking ends in. Leave to rise 1 hour.
Brush with 1 egg and a little water before baking. Spray cookie sheet. Bake at 350°F for 30 to 35 minutes.
Butter crust when cooled. Cover with towel so it cools slowly.
For nut filling, bring milk, margarine, sugar, and ground nuts to a boil. Add more milk to make spreadable. Stir constantly 15 minutes. When cooling, add vanilla.

recipes.title: Cranberry Scones
steps: Mix dry ingredients and cut in butter. Stir in cranberries.
Beat milk and egg in a separate bowl; add to flour mixture. Stir until evenly moistened.
Drop by heaping tablespoons onto a greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 425°F for 12 to 14 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon-Blueberry Muffins
steps: Combine brown sugar, margarine, lemon rind, vanilla, yogurt, egg whites, and egg. Add dry ingredients, stirring until moist.
Fold in blueberries. Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes. Done when they spring back.

recipes.title: Chocolate Raspberry Scones
steps: Mix until moist. Turn onto floured surface and knead lightly, just until a ball forms. Divide in half.
Roll into a circle and spread with raspberry jam. Cover with other half rolled into another circle.
Slice into wedges and bake at 400°F for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry-Raisin Scone
steps: Combine dry ingredients. Cut in butter to resemble coarse crumbs. Add milk, eggs, and raisins. Stir just until dry ingredients are moistened.
With floured hands, pat half the dough in a greased 8-inch round cake pan. Press dough 1/4 inch up sides. Spread jam. Top with remaining dough.
Score dough into 8 wedges. Brush top with melted butter and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 425°F for 20 to 25 minutes or until a pick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Baklava
steps: Boil syrup ingredients for 10 minutes.
Melt butter and brush on each layer of phyllo dough, four layers.
Put nut mixture on lower third, leaving 2/3 inch on edges. Roll up and wrap in wax paper. Refrigerate 10 minutes.
Butter and slice before baking.
Bake at 325°F until golden.
Immediately after the pan comes out of the oven, pour syrup over the rolls. Keep spooning over until almost absorbed.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
steps: Put bread into baking dish. Scald milk and butter. Add sugar, eggs, vanilla, and salt. Blend well and pour over bread.
Mix in raisins. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350°F for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple-Raspberry Cobbler
ingredients: 2 sheets (17.3-ounce package) frozen puff pastry dough, defrosted
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Peel, core, and cut apples into ½-inch-thick slices. Toss with lemon juice in a large bowl.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add apples and cook until just starting to soften, about 5 minutes.

In a small bowl, mix sugar, cinnamon, salt, and apple juice and stir into apples. Cook 10 minutes. Remove from heat and gently stir in vanilla and raspberries. Pour into an 8-inch square glass baking dish.

On a lightly floured surface, fold each pastry sheet into a 10-inch square. Fold one square gently in half and make a few short diagonal cuts along the folded edge to form vents; unfold. From the other sheet, cut decorative shapes using a paring knife.

Beat egg with 1 tablespoon water to make an egg wash. Apply cutout shapes to the first sheet with egg wash. Brush rim and top edge of baking dish with egg wash and lay pastry over top of pan, overhanging the sides but not laying directly on fruit. Press dough to pan to secure. Brush top with egg wash.
Place baking dish on a cookie sheet and bake 30–40 minutes, or until golden brown and evenly puffed.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Rolls
steps: Mix cake ingredients and pour onto a well-greased, wax-paper-lined jelly-roll pan. Sprinkle with nuts.
Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes. Immediately after removing from oven, cover with foil and a dish towel, flip over, and roll up all three. Let cool, then unroll and fill.
Cream filling ingredients together and spread on roll.

recipes.title: Peaches and Cream
ingredients: 1 large can sliced peaches, drained; save juice
steps: Mix first-layer ingredients at medium speed for 2 minutes. Pour into a greased 10-inch pan.
Layer drained sliced peaches over first layer, saving juice.
Beat third-layer ingredients 2 minutes at medium speed. Spoon over first two layers, not quite to edge.
Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon topping on top. Bake at 350°F for 30–35 minutes.
recipes.notes: Cream sugar and cream cheese first before adding juice.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
steps: Place apples in an ungreased baking dish and sprinkle with lemon juice.
Combine brown sugar, oats, margarine, and cinnamon; sprinkle over apples.
Cover and bake 30 minutes at 350°F. Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer, until apples are tender.

recipes.title: Knox Blox
steps: Combine until completely dissolved. Pour into a 13 × 9-inch pan. Chill until firm. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Cinnamon-Pecan Sticky Buns
ingredients: ½ cup plus 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, cut into small pieces
steps: Place ¾ cup flour, yeast, 2 tablespoons sugar, and salt in a food processor fitted with a metal blade; pulse to mix. Heat milk and ½ cup butter in a small saucepan until warm, about 115°F. Add milk mixture to dry ingredients and process 30 seconds.

With motor running, add eggs one at a time. Add lemon juice, zest, and remaining flour and process 30 more seconds. Place dough on a lightly floured surface, knead by hand 5 minutes, and form into a ball.

Coat a large bowl with 1 tablespoon butter. Add dough, turning to coat all sides. Cover with a clean damp towel and let rise in a warm, draft-free place until doubled, about 1 hour. Punch dough down on a lightly floured work surface. Cover with damp towel and rest 15 minutes.
Coat a 10-inch round baking pan with 1 tablespoon butter. Mix 1 cup brown sugar, corn syrup, melted butter, and pecan halves; spread on bottom of prepared pan.
Mix sour cream, chopped pecans, remaining brown sugar, remaining sugar, cinnamon, and egg yolk in a small bowl until combined. Preheat oven to 400°F.

Roll dough into a 20 × 12-inch rectangle. Spread sour cream mixture evenly over dough and roll into a log. Lightly pinch seam to seal. Slice into ten 2-inch-thick pinwheels. Place cut-side down about 1 inch apart in prepared pan. Cover with a damp towel and let rise until doubled and buns touch, about 1 hour.
Bake 35–40 minutes. Let sit 2 minutes and invert onto a serving plate. Cool 5 minutes and serve warm.

recipes.title: Jewish Coffee Cake
steps: Cream margarine, sugar, and eggs together. Add salt, vanilla, sour cream, flour, baking powder, and baking soda.
Grease and flour a tube pan. Layer one-third filling, half the dough, one-third filling, remaining dough, and remaining filling.
Bake at 350°F for 50–55 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Bundt Cake
steps: Grease and flour a Bundt cake pan. Mix ingredients except apples, pecans, and 2 tablespoons flour. Continue to mix.
In a separate bowl, mix apples and reserved 2 tablespoons flour. Fold apples and pecans into batter. Pour into Bundt pan.
Bake at 350°F for 60 minutes, or until tester comes out clean. Cool in pan 15–20 minutes; use knife to loosen from pan.

recipes.title: Banana Cake
steps: Blend ingredients. Pour into a greased and floured pan. Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes or until a pick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
steps: Mix ingredients together; fold in blueberries. Spoon into muffin tins.
Bake at 350°F for 15–20 minutes or until a pick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Spice Cupcakes
steps: Bring water and raisins to a boil in a saucepan. Simmer 10 minutes. Remove from heat; do not drain.
Cream shortening and sugar in a bowl. Add egg and raisins. Combine dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Mix well. Add walnuts.
Fill muffin tins one-third full. Bake at 350°F for 20–25 minutes. Cool 10 minutes in pan.

For frosting, combine brown sugar, half-and-half, and salt in a saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium-low heat. Cook and stir until smooth. Stir in margarine and vanilla. Remove from heat and cool slightly. Stir in powdered sugar until smooth. Frost cupcakes and top with nuts if desired.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Muffins
steps: Beat sugar, egg, and wet ingredients together. Add dry ingredients until moistened; batter will be lumpy.
Fold rhubarb into batter. Spoon into muffin tins. Bake at 375°F for 18–20 minutes.
recipes.notes: 1 cup milk and 1 teaspoon vinegar; let sit 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry-Orange Muffins
steps: Combine flour, ⅔ cup sugar, and dry ingredients; mix well. In a small bowl, toss cranberries with remaining 2 tablespoons sugar.
Stir cranberries into dry ingredients. Add milk, butter, egg, orange peel, and vanilla. Mix until dry ingredients are moistened. Spoon into muffin tins.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Muffins
steps: Mix muffin ingredients together. Fill muffin tins two-thirds full. Bake at 400°F for 18–22 minutes.
For topping, combine lemon juice and sugar in a saucepan. Cook and stir until sugar is dissolved. Use a toothpick to put 6–8 holes in each muffin. Spoon mixture over muffins.

recipes.title: New York Style Cheesecake
ingredients: 5 packages (8 ounces each) cream cheese, softened
steps: Mix crumbs, 3 tablespoons sugar, and margarine. Press into bottom of a 9-inch springform pan. Bake at 350°F for 10 minutes.
Beat cream cheese, 1 cup sugar, flour, and vanilla on medium until well blended. Add eggs one at a time, mixing on low until blended. Blend in sour cream. Pour over crust.
Bake at 350°F for 65 minutes or until center is almost set. Run a knife around rim of pan to loosen. Cool before removing rim. Refrigerate 4 hours.

recipes.title: Cream Puff Cake
ingredients: 2 boxes (3 ounces each) instant vanilla pudding
steps: Microwave water and margarine until margarine melts. Whisk in flour and let cool. Add eggs one at a time by hand.
Spread dough in a 9 × 13-inch pan. Bake at 400°F for 35 minutes. Press bubbles down after baking.
Beat filling ingredients together with a mixer. Pour onto cooled crust. Top with Cool Whip. Melt chocolate chips and drizzle on top.

recipes.title: Blueberry Crisp
steps: Mix together and microwave on high for 10–15 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pretzel Dessert
steps: Mix crust ingredients and put in a 13 × 9-inch pan. Bake at 400°F for 8 minutes and cool.
Mix second-layer ingredients and spread on bottom layer.
Mix third-layer ingredients and let stand 10 minutes. Pour on top of cream cheese mixture and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mousse
steps: Sprinkle gelatin over cold water. Stir and let stand 1 minute to soften. Add boiling water and stir until gelatin is completely dissolved.
Stir sugar and cocoa together in a small cold mixing bowl. Add heavy cream and vanilla. Beat at medium speed until stiff peaks form.
Pour in gelatin mixture and beat until well blended. Spoon into serving dishes. Chill ½ hour.

recipes.title: Pound Cake (Lite)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon grated lemon rind, optional for lemon pound cake
steps: Cream margarine and sugar; gradually add egg substitute. Combine sour cream and baking soda; set aside.
Combine dry ingredients and add alternately with sour cream mixture. Stir in vanilla.
Spoon into a 16-inch tube pan coated with cooking spray. Bake at 325°F for 60 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove from pan.
For lemon pound cake, add 1 teaspoon grated lemon rind.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
ingredients: ⅔ cup margarine or ½ cup Crisco shortening
steps: Cream margarine and sugar together. Add eggs, vanilla, and dry ingredients. Stir in apples and nuts.
Pour into a greased 9 × 13-inch pan; batter will be thick. Sprinkle top with sugar for a crisp top.
Bake 55–60 minutes at 350°F.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
steps: Combine all dry ingredients. Add remaining ingredients except boiling water. After mixing, add boiling water; batter will be thin.
Bake 35–40 minutes at 350°F or until a toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Berry Coffee Cake
steps: For streusel, combine flour, brown sugar, and cinnamon in a bowl. Add diced butter and blend with pastry blender or fingertips until crumbly. Set aside.
Preheat oven to 350°F. Spray a 9 × 13-inch pan with vegetable oil spray. Sift cake flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt together in a large bowl; set aside.
Cream butter and sugar with electric mixer and paddle attachment or a wooden spoon until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Mix in sour cream and vanilla.

Add sifted dry ingredients one-third at a time, mixing just until blended. Gently fold in berries with a rubber spatula. Batter will be very thick. Scrape into pan and spread evenly. Sprinkle streusel over surface.
Bake until golden brown and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean, 45–50 minutes. Cool in pan 10–15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Lemon Meringue Tart
ingredients: ½ cup unsalted butter, cut up and frozen
steps: For pastry dough, pulse flour and sugar together in a food processor. Add butter and pulse to a fine meal. Whisk egg yolk and cream together; add to butter mixture and pulse until dough just comes together.
Gently knead dough on a lightly floured surface and flatten into a disk. Wrap in plastic and chill until firm, 2 hours.

Adjust oven rack to middle. Heat oven to 375°F. Roll dough on a lightly floured surface to a 12-inch circle, ⅛ inch thick. Fit into a 10-inch tart pan and trim pastry even with edge. Freeze until firm. Bake until lightly golden, 10–12 minutes.

For filling, lower oven to 275°F. In a medium saucepan over medium heat, whisk lemon juice and sugar together and cook until sugar dissolves, 1–2 minutes. Whisk eggs and cream in a large bowl. Remove lemon juice mixture from heat and slowly whisk into egg mixture.
Strain custard through a fine-mesh sieve into tart shell. Bake until center still jiggles a little when gently shaken, 30–40 minutes.

Increase oven to 350°F. Cut a 10-inch circle of parchment paper, then cut into 8 individual wedges. Whisk powdered sugar and egg whites in a large mixing bowl over a saucepan of simmering water until smooth and warm to the touch. Remove from heat and whisk in flour.

Spread meringue in a ⅛-inch-thick layer over each wedge of parchment. Transfer to a cookie sheet and bake until meringue rises and top is smooth and lightly brown, 10 minutes. Cool completely, peel off parchment, and set aside.
To serve, cut tart into 8 pieces. Top each with a meringue slice.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Frosting
steps: Cream cream cheese and margarine together. Add vanilla and slowly add sugar.

recipes.title: Buttercream Frosting
steps: Beat butter and shortening 10 minutes.
Gradually add granulated sugar and beat well. Add warm milk and vanilla. Beat 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Whipped Cream Frosting
steps: Beat shortening, sugar, margarine, and vanilla together.
Cook flour and milk until a paste forms. Cool. Add to the beaten mixture a little at a time until thick and no hard sugar remains, about 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Smooth and Creamy Frosting
steps: Combine pudding, milk, and powdered sugar; beat at low speed until blended, about 1 minute.
Fold in Cool Whip. Let stand 5 minutes for firmer frosting. Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: No-Bake Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Mix sugar, cocoa, margarine, and milk and bring to a boil for 1 minute.
Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients. Stir well and drop by spoonful onto wax paper. Let cool.

recipes.title: Crescents
steps: Mix and shape into crescents. Place 2 inches apart on a baking sheet.
Bake at 300°F for 20–25 minutes. When cool, roll in powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Rice Krispie Treats
steps: Melt margarine and marshmallows, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add cereal. Stir until coated.
Pour into a buttered 9 × 13-inch pan and press down. May add peanut butter if desired.

recipes.title: Raisin-Filled Cookies
ingredients: 1 teaspoon baking soda, dissolved in 1 cup sour cream
2½–3 additional cups flour, until dough is easy to handle
1 cup water, plus a little for dissolving flour
steps: Cream margarine and sugar; add eggs. Mix dry ingredients and add alternately with sour cream mixture. Stir in additional flour until dough is easy to handle. Add vanilla.
Chill dough ½ hour. Roll out and cut with a 2-inch cookie cutter. Drop a teaspoonful of raisin filling onto each cookie, top with another cookie, and seal edges with a fork.
Bake at 350°F for 12–15 minutes.
For filling, cook raisins in water for 5 minutes. Add sugar and flour dissolved in a little water. Cook until bubbly and thick.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
ingredients: Raisins, chopped nuts, or chocolate chips, optional
steps: Cream first four ingredients: shortening, brown sugar, sugar, and egg. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Add raisins, chopped nuts, or chocolate chips if desired. Bake at 350°F for 12–15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cookies
steps: Cream shortening and sugars. Add egg and mix in remaining ingredients.
Bake at 350°F for 10–15 minutes.

recipes.title: Jamboree’s
steps: Cream butter and sugar together. Add eggs, then remaining dough ingredients.
Put jam in the middle of each cookie before baking. Bake at 375°F for 10–12 minutes.

recipes.title: Mincemeat Cookies
steps: Cream shortening, sugar, and eggs. Add dry ingredients. Add crumbled mincemeat and mix well.
Drop onto a cookie sheet and bake at 350°F for 8–10 minutes.

recipes.title: Double Chocolate Walnut Drops
steps: Mix and drop by teaspoonful onto a cookie sheet. Bake at 350°F for 12–14 minutes.

recipes.title: Death by Chocolate Cookies
ingredients: 2 packages (16 squares total) semisweet baking chocolate
steps: Coarsely chop 8 squares chocolate and set aside. Microwave remaining 8 squares until melted and smooth.
Stir in brown sugar, margarine, eggs, and vanilla. Stir in dry ingredients, chopped chocolate, and nuts.
Drop by ¼ cupful onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350°F for 12–13 minutes. Cool 1 minute before removing.

recipes.title: Citrus Sugar Cookies
steps: Sprinkle with sugar before baking. Bake at 350°F for 12–15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chewy Chocolate Cookie
steps: Mix together and drop onto an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350°F for 8–9 minutes. Do not overbake; cookies will be soft.
Cool 1 minute.

recipes.title: Lemon Tassies
ingredients: 5 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cut into chunks, plus more for pans
8 ounces cream cheese, at room temperature
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Lightly butter 24 mini-muffin tins and set aside. In a food processor fitted with a steel blade, combine flour and butter; pulse to fine crumbs.
Add sugar, egg yolk, vanilla, lemon zest, and salt. Process until evenly incorporated and smooth; do not overprocess. Divide dough into quarters, then each quarter into 6 equal pieces.

Shape each piece into a ball and place in a muffin cup. Press centers down so dough fits snugly around edges. Set muffin pan on a baking sheet. Bake until lightly browned all over and slightly darker at edges, 15–20 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack to cool.
For filling, beat cream cheese, sugar, egg, lemon zest, lemon juice, and vanilla in an electric mixer until completely smooth. Fill cooled crusts with a small ice cream scoop.
Bake until filling is set and just beginning to color at edges, 10–12 minutes. Transfer muffin pan to a wire rack to cool. Refrigerate in an airtight container to store.

recipes.title: Chrusciki (Polish Bow Tie Cookies)
steps: Melt butter and combine with eggs, egg yolks, sugar, salt, extracts, vinegar, rum, and sour cream in a mixer. Beat on medium until lemon colored. Add citrus zests.
Gradually add enough flour to make a fairly stiff dough. Turn onto a floured board and knead 8–10 minutes, adding flour as necessary, until dough blisters, becomes elastic, and can be handled easily.

Cut dough in half. Wrap one half in plastic wrap and reserve at room temperature. Roll dough very thin and cut into strips about 4 inches long and 1¼ inches wide. Cut ends diagonally. Slit each piece in center and pull one end through slit.

Place on a parchment-lined baking sheet and cover with a towel to keep moist. Heat shortening to 375°F and fry dough strips until lightly browned. Drain on brown paper, transfer to a wire cooling rack, and sprinkle with powdered sugar.
The recipe makes an enormous amount and can be halved, but do not divide the extracts.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 packages (8 ounces each) reduced-fat cream cheese, softened
1 package (8 ounces) fat-free cream cheese, softened
steps: Mix wafer crumbs, margarine, and 3 packets Equal in bottom of a 9-inch springform pan. Reserve 1 tablespoon crumb mixture. Pat remaining mixture evenly on bottom and ½ inch up side.
Bake in preheated 350°F oven until lightly browned, about 8 minutes. Cool on wire rack.
Beat cream cheese and 18 packets Equal in a large bowl until fluffy. Beat in eggs, egg whites, and cornstarch. Mix in sour cream and vanilla until well blended. Pour into crust.
Place cheesecake in a roasting pan on oven rack; add 1 inch hot water to roasting pan. Bake in preheated 300°F oven just until set in center, 45–60 minutes.
Remove cheesecake from roasting pan, sprinkle with reserved crumbs, and return to oven. Turn oven off and cool cheesecake 3 hours in oven with door ajar. Refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Apple Butter
ingredients: 1 cup water, plus more if needed
steps: Peel and slice apples. Place in a heavy saucepan and add water. Cover tightly and cook 5 minutes over moderate heat. Stir and add more water if needed. Uncover and continue cooking until apples are tender.
Heat oven to 350°F. Mix apples with remaining ingredients in a large deep baking dish. Bake 3–4 hours until thick and dark, stirring occasionally.
To can: ladle apple butter into sterilized jars, leaving ¼-inch space. Wipe rims, add lids, and process in boiling water bath for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: No-Cook Strawberry Jam
steps: Mix sugar and crushed strawberries in a large bowl.
In a small saucepan, add water and Sure-Jell. Bring to a boil and boil 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add berries and sugar; stir 2 minutes and put into containers. Let stand 24 hours before freezing or refrigerating.

recipes.title: Berry Lollipops
steps: Brush 2 flat baking sheets with oil. Combine sugar, water, and corn syrup in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, stirring until sugar just dissolves.
Boil over high heat until mixture reaches 280°F, about 20 minutes. Add concentrate and food coloring and cook until temperature reaches 300°F.
When bubbling stops, spoon syrup onto baking sheets. Place a stick in each center, turning to cover it with syrup.

recipes.title: Non-Fat Garlic Spread for Garlic Bread
steps: Place 2 cups garlic cloves on a 9 × 13-inch cookie sheet lightly sprayed with cooking spray. Lightly spray top of garlic and add water to sheet pan. Cover tightly with foil, shiny side down.
Bake in a preheated 350°F oven for 45 minutes, until garlic is well cooked and beginning to brown. Remove garlic and place in a food processor.
Purée with salt and 2 large thinly sliced garlic cloves until smooth and creamy. Add paprika if desired.
