Spread onto French bread and broil in oven until bread is golden.

recipes.title: Vanilla Ice Cream
ingredients: 1–3 tablespoons vanilla or vanilla bean paste, to taste
steps: Add egg yolks and sugar in a medium saucepan. Whisk until well combined.
In another saucepan, heat milk over medium-low heat until it just begins to simmer. Do not stir.
Gradually add milk to egg and sugar mixture, stirring constantly, until mixture reaches 165°F. Do not let it come to a boil.
Remove from heat. Refrigerate in an airtight container. When cool, add cream and vanilla. Pour into ice cream maker.

recipes.title: Hot Dog Relish (Granny Bor’s)
steps: Grind all vegetables. Sprinkle with salt and let stand overnight. Strain and rinse twice.

recipes.title: Pierogi
steps: Mix wet dough ingredients; add dry ingredients. Let rest a few minutes, roll thin, and cut into squares.
Mix filling ingredients and fill the noodle squares as generously or lightly as preferred. Boil approximately 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Boston Cream Pie
steps: For custard, combine 1 cup milk and vanilla in a microwave-safe bowl. Cook 1 minute or until milk is hot.
Whisk sugar and cornstarch in saucepan until blended. Whisk in remaining 1/3 cup milk and egg yolks until smooth. Gradually whisk in hot milk.

Cook over medium heat, whisking, until a full boil. Reduce heat and boil 1 minute. Remove from heat and stir, rather than whisk, in butter until melted. Cover surface directly with plastic wrap and refrigerate 2 hours.
Mix cake ingredients together. Bake in a greased and floured cake pan at 350°F for 35 to 40 minutes.
When cake is cool, cut in half and spread custard in middle. Pour glaze over top after cake is cooled.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Silk Pie
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream, beaten until stiff
steps: Beat cream cheese, sugar, peanut butter, butter, and vanilla until creamy.
Fold in half the beaten heavy cream, then remaining cream until blended. Spread filling in crust. Smooth top.
For topping, melt chocolate chips until smooth. Cool slightly and drizzle on top. Refrigerate 1 hour. Cover loosely with plastic.

recipes.title: Mincemeat Scones
steps: Combine dry ingredients. Cut in butter. Stir in 1 egg, milk, and mincemeat; mix well.
Knead lightly and roll to 1/2 inch thick. Cut into 2-inch circles. Place 1 inch apart on ungreased baking sheets. Brush with beaten egg before baking.
Bake at 400°F for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
ingredients: ½ cup sugar, plus 1 tablespoon for sprinkling
steps: Combine all filling ingredients in an 8-quart Dutch oven. Heat to boiling and boil 1 minute. Spoon into a 13 × 9-inch baking dish and bake 10 minutes at 425°F.
Cut margarine into dry biscuit ingredients. Stir ⅔ cup half-and-half into flour mixture just until blended and a soft dough forms. Turn dough onto floured surface and cut into squares.
Remove baking dish from oven. Place biscuits on top and brush with remaining half-and-half. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sugar. Return to oven and bake 35 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Yellow Sheet Cake
steps: Beat butter until creamy on medium speed. Add sugar and beat until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time, beating 1 minute after each egg.

Add milk alternately with dry ingredients just until blended. Spread batter into a greased and floured 9 × 13-inch pan. Bake at 350°F for 18–20 minutes, rotating the pan halfway through, until a pick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake with Chocolate Pecan Frosting
steps: Grease and flour a 13 × 9-inch pan. Whisk flour, sugar, and baking soda in a large bowl.
In a medium saucepan, bring butter, margarine, water, and cocoa to a boil over high heat, stirring to dissolve butter and margarine. Pour into flour mixture and whisk well.
Add sour cream, then eggs and vanilla; beat well. Spread evenly in pan. Bake at 350°F for 35 minutes, or until cake springs back.
For frosting, bring butter, milk, and cocoa to a boil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Gradually stir in powdered sugar, then vanilla. Pour over warm cake. Cool cake in pan.

recipes.title: Cheesecake (Mom’s)
ingredients: 2 packages (8 ounces each) cream cheese, softened
1 can Pet evaporated milk, chilled and whipped
steps: Pour half the crust into pan. Combine filling ingredients and pour on top of crust. Sprinkle remaining crust on top.
Refrigerate 4 hours or overnight.
recipes.notes: The printed “24 graham crackers” is crossed out, with “2 packages” handwritten beside it.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
steps: Mix dough ingredients together, roll into balls, and roll in cinnamon and sugar mixture.
Place 2 inches apart on a baking sheet and bake at 350°F for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Toll House Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugars. Add eggs, gradually add dry ingredients, and stir in chocolate chips.
Bake at 350°F for 8–10 minutes.
recipes.notes: Handwritten flour change: 2½ cups or more.

recipes.title: Molasses Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream shortening, sugar, and egg; beat well. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Cover and chill. Roll into 1-inch balls and roll in sugar. Bake at 375°F for 8–10 minutes.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Bake at 350°F for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Crock Pickles
ingredients: Cucumbers, enough to be completely covered by the brine
steps: Boil the brine ingredients together and pour over cucumbers in a crock, using enough brine to cover them completely.
Keep in the refrigerator and let stand 2 days.

recipes.title: Spiced Maple Pecans
steps: Spread pecans in a roasting pan. Bake at 350°F until lightly toasted, about 8 minutes.
Combine syrups and pour over nuts to coat well. Bake, stirring occasionally, until most syrup has been absorbed, about 10 minutes.
Mix dry ingredients. Pour nuts into a bowl and toss with a spoon, gradually adding spice mixture. Cool slightly and break apart. Pour onto a baking sheet to cool.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Minestrone
ingredients: 1 cup dried great northern beans, presoaked overnight
1 can (14 1/2 ounces) whole tomatoes, coarsely chopped, with juice
2 cups vegetable stock, broth, or water
1 medium zucchini, unpeeled, quartered lengthwise and sliced
3/4 cup uncooked macaroni or other small pasta
steps: In a large soup pot over high heat, combine drained beans, tomatoes, tomato juice, vegetable stock, broth, or water, onion, carrots, celery, parsley, salt, basil, thyme, oregano, and pepper.
Bring vegetable mixture to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, about 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Add cabbage, zucchini, and macaroni and continue cooking over medium-low heat, covered, until macaroni and vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.

For thicker soup, remove about 1 cup of vegetables and allow to cool before puréeing in a food processor or blender. Return purée to soup pot and simmer over medium-low heat, uncovered, until blended. Top with grated cheese.

recipes.title: Hot-Cross Buns
ingredients: 1 cup plus 1 tablespoon milk, warmed to 110°F
2 tablespoons candied lemon peel, cut into 1/4-inch pieces
2 tablespoons candied orange peel, cut into 1/4-inch pieces
steps: Coat a large bowl with oil and set aside. Combine 1 cup milk, yeast, and 1 teaspoon sugar in a small bowl and let stand until bubbly.

Combine the flours, remaining sugar, raisins, candied peels, salt, and spices in the bowl of a mixer. Add butter, 2 eggs, and the yeast mixture and continue to mix until a sticky dough forms, about 3 minutes.

Transfer dough to a lightly floured surface and knead by hand until smooth, about 5 minutes. Form dough into a ball, place it in prepared bowl, and turn to coat all sides with oil. Cover with a damp towel and let rise until doubled, about 1 hour.

Line a baking pan with parchment paper and set aside. Punch dough down, transfer to a slightly floured surface, and knead for 3 minutes. Divide dough into 12 equal-sized pieces and place them an equal distance apart in the baking pan. Cover and let rise for about 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Brush the risen buns with the egg yolk before baking.
Preheat oven to 500°F, reduce oven to 400°F and bake for 20 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack.

In a small bowl combine powdered sugar, remaining milk, and vanilla. Stir until smooth. When buns have cooled slightly, drizzle a horizontal line across each row of buns followed by a vertical line to form a cross on each bun.

recipes.title: Chicken Lo Mein
steps: Cook linguine according to package directions and drain.
Whisk together the sauce ingredients and set aside.
Heat oil over medium-high heat and add vegetables. Stir-fry 3 minutes or until tender. Add chicken and stir-fry 1 minute or until heated.
Stir in sauce and pasta. Cook 4 minutes or until pasta is coated.

recipes.title: French Onion Chicken
ingredients: Lipton onion soup mix, to suit
Chicken, quantity and cut to suit
steps: Mix French dressing, onion soup mix, and jellied cranberries to suit your taste. Pour over chicken and bake at 350°F for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: The Best Guacamole
steps: In a food processor with knife blade attached, finely chop garlic, jalapeño, and cilantro.
Halve avocados and remove pits. With a spoon, scoop out avocados into a large bowl; add cilantro mixture and remaining ingredients except yucca crisps.
Mash with a potato masher or the back of a fork.
Cover surface of guacamole with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve; serve with yucca crisps.

recipes.title: Cranberry Raspberry Flirtini
ingredients: Champagne or sparkling wine, to preference
steps: In a shaker, combine cranberry juice, raspberry liqueur, and vodka.
Shake gently and strain into a martini glass.
Add chilled orange juice and champagne or sparkling wine to preference. Top with fresh cranberries.

recipes.title: Lemon Squares
steps: Lightly spray bottom of a 13 × 9-inch pan. Combine crust ingredients until well blended; mixture will be crumbly. Firmly press into bottom of pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350°F.
Mix filling and pour over hot crust. Bake for 25–30 minutes at 350°F or until edges are lightly browned and filling is set.
Cool completely. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Pumpkin-Raisin Bars
steps: Grease a 15 × 9-inch pan for bars and a 13 × 9-inch pan for cake. Mix all ingredients except nuts and raisins. Beat until well mixed. Stir in nuts and raisins. Pour into pan.
Bake at 350°F for 25–30 minutes or until a pick comes out clean.
For frosting, cream together the frosting ingredients and spread on cooled cake.

recipes.title: Cut-Out Cookies
steps: Roll out; cut out; and bake at 375°F for 10 minutes.
